title: Cajun Parmesan chicken pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Toss chicken with Cajun seasoning. Sear in oil and some butter until golden; remove.
Sauté garlic in remaining butter. Add broth and cream; simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan, then pasta and a splash of pasta water. Add chicken, lemon, and parsley.
